entities.name: Server Software Component: Web Shell
entities.evidence: Iranian cyber actors capture login credentials on compromised Netscaler devices via deployed webshell; create a directory on Netscaler devices for webshell deployment; deploy webshells on compromised Netscaler devices in two directories (observed closely after system owning patching); and place the malicious backdoor version.dll.

entities.name: Create Account (Local Account)
entities.evidence: Iranian cyber actors create local accounts on victim networks.

entities.name: Account Manipulation
entities.evidence: Iranian cyber actors request exemptions to zero-trust application for tools they intend to deploy.

entities.name: Scheduled Task/Job
entities.evidence: Iranian cyber actors implement a scheduled task that uses a DLL side-loading technique and a scheduled task that loads malware through back doors.

entities.name: Server Software Component
entities.evidence: Iranian cyber actors implement the daily creation of a Windows service task for persistence as detection and mitigation occur.

entities.name: Valid Accounts: Local Accounts
entities.evidence: Iranian cyber actors repurpose compromised credentials (e.g., from a Netscaler device) to log into other applications.

entities.name: Valid Accounts: Domain Accounts
entities.evidence: Iranian cyber actors repurpose administrative credentials of network admins to log into domain controllers and other infrastructure.

entities.name: Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Tools
entities.evidence: Iranian cyber actors use administrator credentials to disable antivirus and security software.

entities.name: Impair Defenses: Downgrade Attack
entities.evidence: Iranian cyber actors lower PowerShell policies to a less secure level.

entities.name: Input Capture
entities.evidence: Iranian cyber actors capture login credentials on compromised Netscaler devices via a deployed webshell.

entities.name: Command and Scripting
entities.evidence: Iranian cyber actors use an admin account to initiate a remote desktop session to start Microsoft Windows PowerShell ISE.

entities.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter
entities.evidence: Iranian cyber actors enable servers to use Windows PowerShell Web Access.

entities.name: Query Registry
entities.evidence: Iranian cyber actors export registry hives and network firewall configurations.

entities.name: Domain Trust Discovery
entities.evidence: Iranian cyber actors exfiltrate account usernames from the domain controller and access configuration files and logs.

entities.name: Remote Access Software
entities.evidence: Iranian cyber actors install “AnyDesk” remote access program.

entities.name: Protocol Tunneling
entities.evidence: Iranian cyber actors use ligolo / ligolo-ng for open source tunneling and ngrok[.]io NGROK to create outbound connections to a random subdomain.
